documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: An earlier inquiry from our consulting operations team requested discovery about unclear ownership. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's operational friction involves 'unclear ownership' and 'contradictory project information' as noted in the customer inquiry and call evidence. These issues are blocking progress and require clarification before moving forward.

claims.quote: An earlier inquiry from our consulting operations team requested discovery about unclear ownership.
The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement.

raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your team has encountered challenges with unclear ownership and contradictory project information, which are currently pausing progress. To ensure we align with your needs, could you clarify the current project status and confirm the owner's position on the requirement? This will help us proceed effectively.
questions: Could you clarify the current project status and confirm who the owner is?
What specific points of disagreement exist regarding the requirement?
uncertainties: The exact nature of the disagreement between the owner and the consulting operations team is unclear.
The current project status is described as paused, but the reason is not specified.
